Frequently asked questions

How can I analyse my chess game for free?

Open the analysis tool on Chess Nexus, load your game and get an instant move-by-move review — accuracy score, blunder detection, piece heatmap and more — completely free, with no ads.

What is a CAPS / accuracy score?

It's a single number that summarises how accurately you played a game, based on your average centipawn loss per move. A higher accuracy and lower loss means cleaner, more precise play.

Will analysis tell me where I went wrong?

Yes. The review flags every blunder, mistake and inaccuracy, shows the stronger move, highlights which pieces let you down and reveals whether time pressure hurt your accuracy.
